core_obligations: First proof: reduce to the affine case using the affine-local criterion for relative perfectness, then apply the More on Algebra base-change lemma for relatively perfect complexes (proof lines 9031-9035).

Second proof: L(g')^*K is pseudo-coherent by the cohomology pseudo-coherent pullback lemma, and its bounded tor dimension over S' follows from the tor-independence tor-amplitude lemma; together these give S'-perfectness (proof lines 9037-9041).
proof_roadmap: Give the direct proof via pseudo-coherence and tor independence (proof lines 9037-9041).
